name: formula
description: Calculated run current for TMC stepper driver

name: peak_current
description: Peak current from stepper motor specification sheet

name: rms_factor
description: RMS conversion factor (sine wave RMS = peak * 0.707)

name: common_motors
description: NEMA17 17HS19-2004S1: 2.0A peak, Moons MS17HD6P4200: 2.0A peak, OMC 17HS19-2004S1: 2.0A peak, LDO 42STH48-2504AH: 2.5A peak

name: safety_note
description: Round down to nearest 0.1A. Start 10-20% below calculated value and increase gradually while monitoring temperature.

name: usage_note
description: Update [tmc2209 stepper_x], [tmc2209 stepper_y], [tmc2209 stepper_z] sections in printer.cfg with calculated run_current value.
